Class SysMLVertex

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLVertex
Direct Known Subclasses:
SysMLPseudoState, SysMLState
public abstract class SysMLVertex extends SysMLAction
SysMLinJava representation of the SysMLinJava state machine's vertex. The SysMLVertex is used solely as a base class for state and pseudo-state classes. Modelers should have no use for this class.

ModelerOne
